subject: PO-required: payment waterfall, invoice cadence & VAT evidence
messages:
From: AcroMed Billing <billing@acromed.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PO request — proposed payment waterfall + VAT evidence

Hi Vanessa,

Per our procurement guidelines we need a PO-backed payment schedule before we can route invoices to Accounts Payable. Our procurement team has proposed the following waterfall to match our internal milestone sign-offs: 

- 30% on PO issuance (to be invoiced on receipt of PO)
- 40% on pilot acceptance (completion of integration UAT)
- 30% net30 after production acceptance

We also need Redwood's confirmation of VAT handling: please provide Redwood's VAT ID or the documentation you require so we can apply reverse-charge on our side. Our AP runs payments twice monthly (1st and 15th cutoffs) — can you confirm if invoices will be timed to those runs?

We can circulate a PO once payment cadence and VAT evidence are in scope. Attached is the preliminary PO template our team fills out (we can send the formal PO once terms are agreed).

Thanks,

Luca Moretti
Billing Manager, AcroMed Health Systems
AcroMed Billing Team
Attachment: AcroMed_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: AcroMed Billing <billing@acromed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request — proposed payment waterfall + VAT evidence

Hi Luca — thanks for the clear outline. Happy to work to your procurement rhythm. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We can accept a PO-anchored waterfall, but Redwood Finance typically requests an initial prepayment to cover ramp (20% is standard for new enterprise pilots). If AcroMed can do 20% on PO issue we can reduce the remainder to 40/40 or keep your 30/40/30 split — flexible.
- VAT: we will accept reverse-charge where applicable. Please send your VAT registration certificate; we will provide Redwood's VAT ID and a short VAT treatment confirmation doc for your records.
- Invoices: we can align invoice dates to your bi-monthly AP runs if you advise exact desired invoice dates relative to milestone completion.

Ive attached the current SOW (Proposed_SOW_v2.pdf) with milestone callouts so we can map invoices to deliverables. Once we have the formal PO and VAT cert Ill loop Legal/Finance to finalize the billing amendment.

Next steps:
1) Send PO and VAT cert to billing@redwood.com
2) Confirm whether AcroMed prefers 20% prepay or 10% prepay (Finance may accept 10% in exchange for an on-demand credit check)
3) Confirm your preferred invoice dates for the 2nd/16th runs

Thanks — Ill await the docs and will c.c. Karthik from Finance for the credit side.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Proposed_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request — credit & invoicing constraints

Vanessa — quick finance note to share constraints so we don't get downstream surprises: 

- Credit cap: we can support a PO-anchored waterfall for this account provided there is either (a) a 20% prepayment, or (b) a 10% prepayment + formal credit check completed by our AR team. Given AcroMed is large but new to Redwood, the conservative ceiling will be $200,000 until we complete the credit assessment.
- Net terms: Finance prefers net45 for milestone invoices on first engagements; if AcroMed requires net30 we'll need explicit executive approval or a deposit ladder.
- VAT: please ensure AcroMed's VAT certificate is an official government-issued document (PDF) with VAT ID and effective dates. If we apply reverse-charge we'll update the invoice line items accordingly and include our VAT ID.

If AcroMed agrees to a 10% prepay + credit check we can make an exception on prepay and set net45 on subsequent invoices. Please capture their preferred option in writing and attach the PO and VAT cert.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
From: AcroMed Billing <billing@acromed.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@acromed.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request — payment waterfall + VAT cert (PO attached)

Hi Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks — we can accommodate Redwood's request on prepay. Procurement is willing to move 10% on PO issue (instead of 20%) provided Redwood performs a standard credit check. Procurement also wants the final invoice schedule to align to our AP runs (1st and 15th).

Attached are: 
- AcroMed_PO_78912.pdf (the formal PO with PO number)
- AcroMed_VATCert.pdf (VAT registration certificate with VAT ID)

We accept the following revised cadence: 10% on PO, 40% on pilot acceptance, 50% net45 after production acceptance (we can be flexible on the last split if Redwood insists on 30/40/30). Please confirm Redwood's VAT ID and we will apply reverse-charge where appropriate.

Also: our AP needs invoices dated such that they hit either the 1st or 15th cutoffs. Can Redwood time the invoice generation to those dates?

Regards,

Luca Moretti
Billing Manager, AcroMed Health Systems
Attachments: AcroMed_PO_78912.pdf (pdf), AcroMed_VATCert.pdf (pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: AcroMed Billing <billing@acromed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request — confirmed; SOW & billing addendum sent for signature

Luca — great, thanks for sending the PO and VAT cert. Well proceed with the 10% prepay + credit check option per Karthik's note. Next steps on our side: 

1) Ive attached a short Invoice Schedule Addendum (Invoice_Schedule_Addendum.docx) that maps the PO and milestones to invoice dates timed to your 1st/15th AP runs. Please review and confirm the exact invoice target days (e.g., invoice dated the 1st for pilot acceptance completed between the 16th-31st).
2) DocuSign link to SOW + Addendum: https://docusign.net/AcroMed-SOW-123 — please route to the appropriate signatory.
3) Redwood VAT ID: GB999999999 (this will appear on all invoices; we will add a VAT treatment note indicating reverse charge where AcroMed has provided a valid VAT cert).

Once the signed SOW and addendum are back and the credit check clears we will schedule the initial invoice for the 10% prepay and mark the account with a $225,000 temporary credit limit pending the full review. Ive c.c.\"d Neha in Collections to begin the credit workflow.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Invoice_Schedule_Addendum.docx (docx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PO request — final finance confirmation

Confirming finance approval: conditional credit limit of $225,000 has been provisionally granted pending (a) signed SOW + Invoice Addendum, (b) receipt of the 10% prepayment invoice collection, and (c) successful credit check results. 

Once the prepay posts we'll create milestone invoices timed to AcroMed's 1st/15th runs as outlined in the addendum. Neha, please kick off the credit check and confirm estimated turnaround.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

On Sat, Dec 12, 2026 at 09:00 AM PST Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Luca — great, thanks for sending the PO and VAT cert. We'll proceed with the 10% prepay + credit check option per Karthik's note. 

Neha Kapoor (Collections) replied: 
"Credit check opened (expected 3 business days). Will update AR ticket HS-873291 with results."
